claims.value: Qwen3Guard-Stream is a safety moderation model built on Qwen3 with a token-level classification head for real-time safety monitoring during incremental text generation. It supports 119 languages and provides three-tiered severity classification.
claims.evidence: **Qwen3Guard-Stream**, which incorporates a token-level classification head for real-time safety monitoring during incremental text generation... Supports 119 languages and dialects
supports adaptation to diverse deployment scenarios... robust performance in global and cross-lingual applications
